title: Presentation in a meeting space with large projected screen and Innovation Academy banner

One person is presenting at the front of the room and holding a handheld microphone.
One large illuminated projection screen or video wall occupies the right-central background of the image.
One free‑standing vertical roll-up banner is visible at the far right with printed text and logos.
One small round table or laptop stand with a laptop is positioned near the banner at the far right; the laptop is open and facing the audience.
One wheeled AV or utility table is visible at the right under the banner and near the laptop stand.
At least eight individual cube seats (soft upholstered blocks) are visible in the seating area in the centre and foreground; some cubes are partially obscured by people or cropping.
One backpack is visible on the floor in front of the cube seats in the foreground.

One wall-mounted speaker is visible above the projection screen area at center-left of the screen.

A visible exposed metal air duct is present at the top right corner of the image.
